blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, Philippines — Former Finance Undersecretary Cielo Magno, who has announced her bid for the Senate in 2028, said that restoring public confidence in the government is essential to reversing what she described as the “dismal and scary” state of the Philippine economy. Speaking at a press conference hosted by businessman Ramon Uy here on Friday, Nov. 20, Magno said that the country’s economic growth is slowing down and that the government has missed its targets for gross domestic product (GDP) growth and inflation.
